Position  : Full Time 
Location : Goulburn NSW
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year


Hidrive designs, manufactures and installs light, strong, fit-for-purpose service bodies for utes, trailers, and trucks — trusted by trades, industry and governments since 1993. Hidrive is Australia’s only service body manufacturer with a company-owned national installation network, and it designs, builds and installs fit-for-purpose service bodies for all trades and industries at our company-owned facilities in Adelaide, Brisbane, Goulburn, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney.

Hidrive is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Press Brake Operator to join their team.
  
The Press Brake Operator is responsible for setting up and operating CNC press brake machinery to bend, form, and fabricate sheet metal components in accordance with engineering drawings and production specifications. The role ensures products are manufactured accurately, efficiently, and to the required quality standards while maintaining a safe working environment.

Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate CNC press brakes
Program and operate press brakes, when necessary, not mandatory
Select correct tooling and develop bend sequences
Read and interpret engineering drawings
Perform first-off and in-process quality checks
Maintain productivity and quality standards during night shift
Troubleshoot bending issues and adjust programs where required
Maintain a clean and safe workspace

Skills & Experience
At least 2 years of relevant experience 
Relevant qualification
Proven experience as a Press Brake Operator
Experience working with CNC press brake machines
Ability to work independently without supervision
Strong sheet metal fabrication knowledge
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
High attention to detail and quality


If you think you have got the skills and experience to join our team, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Role

This role requires a commitment to working as part of a team, adaptablity to a changing environment, the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and flexibility to work potential overtime hours when required. General duties for this role include but are not limited to:

We assist designers, architects, builders and engineers in the design and fabrication of their sheetmetal requirements. We specialise in stainless steel and aluminium products and also provide metal roofing and rainwater goods.

Follow specifications and calculations to create various technical drawings
Prepare both rough sketches and detailed design work with CADD systems
Calculate dimensions, weight limitations and requirements in materials
Outline the construction process of the project on the technical drawings
Communicate with architects and engineers, and incorporating knowledge gained into drawings.
Prepare, review and redraft alongside the engineering team.
Ensure final designs are compliant with AS/NZ & ISO standards, including building regulations
Carry out design and development of products, including verification and validation of designs
Identify and communicate potential design problems to the rest of the team.
Keeping abreast of the latest developments and technologies in CADD systems/software.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
At least more than 4-years of experience in CADD
Profound knowledge in CAD software e.g AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong organisational and time management skills
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

result.description:
Who We Are
We're a proud Tasmanian family-owned business with over a century of experience in general engineering. Our modern fabrication and machining workshops are located just 10 minutes south of Hobart in Kingston. We specialise in the manufacture, repair, refurbishment, installation, and maintenance of industrial equipment.

The Opportunity
We're on the lookout for skilled Boilermaker Welders to join our dynamic team. Our workshop operations cover a wide range of fabrication and welding tasks, from light to heavy work with steel, stainless steel and aluminium components. You'll work from engineering drawings and use equipment such as CNC plasma cutters, plate rolls, brake presses, bandsaws, and various welding techniques such as MIG, TIG and stick.

What You'll Do
Operate equipment such as plate rolls, rotators, bandsaws, presses and overhead cranes.
Use a variety of welding equipment including MIG, TIG, and stick.
Fabricate steel, aluminium, and stainless-steel components and assemblies.
Carryout repairs on plant and equipment.
Perform welding tasks that range from basic general-purpose applications to coded welding on quality-critical components and equipment.

Why Join Us?
At Saunders & Ward, we offer:
The option to work a 4-day week.
Excellent working conditions.
Stable employment with a well-established, family-owned company.
A diverse range of stimulating work.
Modern, well-organised and clean workshops.
A friendly, safety-focused culture.
Regular overtime.
A graded pay structure that rewards skills and experience.
Annual performance and wage reviews.
Rostered days off (RDOs).

What We're Looking For
To be successful in this role, you should have:
A strong commitment to safe work practices.
A fabrication trade qualification.
Engineering workshop experience.
Experience with mild steel MIG welding and fabrication.
The ability to complete jobs on time and to quality standards.
The ability to pass drug and alcohol screening.

If you're ready to bring your skills and experience to a great team, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your cover letter and resume to our Fabrication Manager, Matt Brown, via our online application.

result.description:
Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson 
Locations: Jancourt East 3266 and Simpson 3266 
Tenure: Full-time, permanent
Salary: From $71,550 per year (plus superannuation)
 
Required skills and experience:
•	AQF Certificate III in Agriculture / Dairy Production (or higher equivalent)
•	Three (3) years of recent and relevant work experience

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Jancourt East 3266 and Simpson 3266. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
 
Qualified applicants may apply online.
